responsibility: Implements Xtensa ABI lowering by tracking available argument and return GPRs, enforcing alignment-sensitive register allocation for aggregates and varargs, coercing register-passed aggregates into 32/64-bit integer chunks, using stack offsets when registers are exhausted, and widening sub-32-bit scalars.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `spec/base/xtensa.rs`, which supplies reusable target defaults for Xtensa targets, this file implements the Xtensa function-call ABI itself: GPR-budget tracking, alignment-sensitive register allocation, stack fallback, and scalar widening.
